_comment: Canonical error envelopes returned by POST /api/v1/sessions/:id/dispatch. AIWG-side dispatch router should surface these to callers as typed errors.

_body.title: Agent not connected
_body.detail: executor_filter.agent_id 'agent-99' is not currently connected to this executor

_body.title: Executor unavailable
_body.detail: executor not registered, no agents connected, or mission store unavailable

_body.title: Dispatch failure
_body.detail: dispatcher couldn't start the session; mission state transitioned to Failed and mission.failed event was emitted
